profile.name: Manish Kumar
profile.headline: Generative AI & Backend Systems Engineer
profile.tagline: Crafting high-throughput FastAPI microservices, agentic AI pipelines & computer vision architectures.
profile.bio: Electrical Engineering undergraduate at IIT Mandi with hands-on industry experience in Generative AI, LLM multi-agent orchestration, speech/lip-sync data pipelines, and medical image segmentation. Passionate about building robust, high-performance backends and cutting-edge deep learning systems.

skills.description: Deep learning architectures, LLM orchestration, and multimodal data pipelines.
High-concurrency microservices, asynchronous task queues, and resilient databases.
Core languages for high-performance computing, scripting, and system design.
DevOps, multimedia tooling, and interactive data visualization.

highlights: Developed Python/FastAPI backend services and asynchronous REST APIs for Generative AI applications with rigorous Pydantic validation.
Engineered speech and lip-sync data pipelines integrating audio ingestion, shot segmentation, MediaPipe landmark extraction, Whisper ASR, phoneme mapping, and automated quality filtering.
Contributed to LLM-powered AI Avatar and multi-agent systems using LangChain, custom prompt engineering, and agent orchestration for context-aware conversational workflows.
Worked with PostgreSQL, Alembic, Docker, and CloudEvents in event-driven microservices across Zangoh Studio, Zangoh ASR, and Video Platform.

experience.company: STAC (Space Technology & Astronomy Club), IIT Mandi
highlights: Coordinated hackathons and technical symposiums on National Space Day 2024 with 200+ participants.
Mentored junior cohorts in Python for scientific computing, astronomy data analysis, and open-source tooling.

projects.title: Graph-Based Neural Cellular Automata for Medical Image Segmentation
projects.description: Novel hybrid architecture combining Vision GNN (ViG-UNet) and Med-NCA for high-resolution 2D medical image segmentation.
projects.full_description: Designed an innovative medical segmentation network pairing Graph Neural Networks with Cellular Automata. Integrated multi-resolution NCA for memory-efficient processing and patch-wise refinement, surpassing previous state-of-the-art benchmarks on clinical segmentation datasets.
architecture: Stage 1: Vision Graph Neural Network (ViG) graph node clustering for global anatomical representation
Stage 2: Multi-resolution Neural Cellular Automata (Med-NCA) local patch refinement
Loss: Combined Dice + Focal Loss with multi-scale deep supervision

projects.title: VesselNet: Scleral Vein Segmentation for Health Monitoring
projects.description: Two-stage deep learning pipeline combining U-Net scleral isolation and SegNet vascular segmentation with FastAPI inference service.
projects.full_description: Engineered an end-to-end vascular health analysis suite. Implemented CLAHE image preprocessing, morphological post-processing for vein continuity, and quantitative feature extraction for vein tortuosity, width, and branching density.
architecture: Stage 1: U-Net for precise scleral eye region masking
Stage 2: SegNet for micro-vein semantic segmentation
Post-processing: CLAHE adaptive contrast + skeletonization morphological filters
API: FastAPI async microservice for batch image processing

projects.title: FieldWise: Geospatial Agricultural Monitoring Platform
projects.description: Satellite imagery analytics platform using Sentinel data, Leafmap interactive GIS, and Google Gemini API for regional crop insights.
projects.full_description: Built a comprehensive agricultural dashboard using Sentinel satellite feeds. Calculates NDVI (Normalized Difference Vegetation Index), surface moisture levels, and vegetation health indices, with Gemini AI generating customized agronomist advisory reports.
projects.metrics: Live GIS mapping + Automated AI crop advisory generation
architecture: NDVI computation & false-color infrared spectral analysis
Interactive polygon boundary selection via Leafmap
Gemini 1.5 Pro integration for context-aware soil & weather analysis

projects.title: Agentic AI Multimodal Avatar & Lip-Sync Pipeline
projects.description: End-to-end multi-agent orchestration service with Whisper ASR, phoneme alignment, and face mesh synthesis.
projects.full_description: Built an asynchronous pipeline converting speech inputs into synchronized conversational agent video streams. Orchestrated with LangChain, FastAPI task workers, and real-time landmark extraction.
projects.metrics: Sub-second speech-to-intent latency & automated quality scoring
architecture: LangChain agent tool calling & response generation
